customManagers.description: nixpkgs commit the Attic client comes from: the nixos-unstable head
Nix release. NIX_SHA256 is not updated: fixed by hand in the pull request
yamllint, run by the lint job (pipx run yamllint==<version>)

packageRules.description: The daily nixos-unstable bump: merged by Renovate once the build passed (not GitHub's auto-merge, which would merge before CI without required checks)

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `NIX_SHA256` is not updated by Renovate, and the build fails until it is: take it from https://nixos.org/nix/install (or `curl -fsSL https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-{{{newVersion}}}/nix-{{{newVersion}}}-x86_64-linux.tar.xz | sha256sum`) and push it to this branch.
